defaults.setup: Materialize the referenced history scenario in one real temporary project without using inspection to derive its expected state.
defaults.action: Call inspect_run or prepare_work through the packaged core dispatcher for the exact Run ID.

rows.oracle: Any normative corruption prevents state and mutation; valid artifacts have recomputed contexts and contracted JSON.
The greatest matching successful attempt is selected regardless of filename, time, mtime, directory, or completion order.
Complete, runnable, blocked, and stale node literals match the exact predecessor and context conditions.
Valid all-complete history is complete, other valid history is incomplete, and invalid history yields no scheduling value or mutation.
Resume reuses exact-context success, prepares each opportunity once, continues independent branches, and performs no hidden retry.
Successful refresh selects the higher identity and stales consumers even for equal bytes; non-success preserves prior selection.
Live edits affect only new Runs; Input/artifact mutation invalidates exact history and no Result crosses a Run ID.
An unchanged copy has identical derived state independent of root/Git, while conflicting divergent identity invalidates merge.
Inspection returns deterministic nodes, next attempts, attempts, stale/non-success facts, and all Selected Terminal Results without writes.
The public state catalog names every required selection, refresh, resume, mutation, copy, state, attempt, and Terminal Result scenario.
